high_level_description: The image is a news article headline and accompanying photograph from "The Hindu Bureau." The headline reads: "Sabarimala gold 'theft' case: Kerala SIT arrests prime accused Unnikrishnan Potti." The text provides context about the case, stating that Mr. Unnikrishnan Potti, who worked as an assistant to a TDB-appointed priest at Sabarimala in the early 2010s, revealed that two copper-gold overlays he had donated to the temple in 2019 were missing. These overlays were later recovered at his sister's residence. The update date is October
